source: Game Concept/narrative/FINAL_SCRIPT.md, SC07 and its encounter notes. Lines marked "system": true are gameplay feedback, hints or placeholder prompts that are not in the script; review them before release.

arrive.text: The fortress. Empty carts are trapped against the gate. A royal order is still nailed above the entrance.

arrive.speaker: VEYA
arrive.text: So does everyone downstream. That's why it stays here.

arrive.speaker: NALI
arrive.text: Open the clinic door. I have medicine.
Veya recognises Nali and lowers a ladder. She is repairing machinery, not sitting on a throne.

arrive.speaker: VEYA
arrive.text: The wheel holds a cracked gate shut. Take it now and the upper reservoir drains into the lower wards.

arrive.speaker: VEYA
arrive.text: Then help me make it safe to remove.

drain.text: Tavo opens the side channel. The water behind the cracked gate drops.

drain_done.text: The side channel is running. The level is holding low.

brace_early.text: The brace won't shift while the channel is full. Drain it first.

brace.text: Tavo shifts the brace under the cracked gate. It takes the load.

key_early.text: The mechanism is still under load. Brace the gate first.

key.text: Sena's key fits. The sluice lock turns.
Behind the sluice grille, a sleeping man whispers in Tavo's own voice.

key.speaker: NALI
key.text: He's alive. Don't pull him out until I see the chain.

veya.speaker: VEYA
veya.text: Drain, brace, key. In that order, or the crack runs.

nali.speaker: NALI
nali.text: The clinic is through there. Make it safe and I'll go in.
